title: Cliffhanger
description: Tea Master Liu Su has lost his train of thought while telling his story, and it's troubling him...

mainQuestExcel.title: Cliffhanger
mainQuestExcel.description: Tea Master Liu Su has lost his train of thought while telling his story, and it's troubling him...

dialogs.text: I wish I could remember where I got up to...
What's wrong?
Ah, hello! Are you here for the story session, or—
Me? I'm a storyteller. I do it to earn a bit of extra spending money.
The problem is, I tell so many stories and go back and forth between them so much that I end up getting things a little bit mixed up...

The other day, for instance, one crowd was shouting for The Crux's story "The Wrath of Haishan," while the other crowd kept chanting "We want Ring of Raining Blades! We want Ring of Raining Blades!" Can't blame them — Guhua classic, that one.
I have to earn a living, now don't I? So I just picked the part I remembered best from each story to keep everybody happy.
It was an unexpected hit... They loved it so much they keep pestering me to tell them the rest of the story!

Since I hadn't read either of those books in years, I dug around for a while and eventually managed to find them. I've had a look through to refresh my memory, and now I'm almost ready to continue with the story.
However... I cannot for the life of me remember where I got up to with either story!
Could you ask around in the crowd and see if anyone remembers where I finished last time?
Okay.
You're a life saver! I know it's a pain, but to do that myself would be career suicide for a storyteller...
Now I think about it, there are three people you should ask.
The first is <color=#00E1FFFF>Gentry Maocai</color>. That man has never missed a single session. The second is <color=#00E1FFFF>Fan Er'ye</color>, who is the boss of this tea shop.
The third is Ms. <color=#00E1FFFF>Jiangzhou</color>. I definitely saw her stop and listen for a while last time, but I think she left before the end...
You could just start from the beginning?
I did think of doing that! Amongst other things, it seemed like an easy way to charge people twice for the same content...
...But I have a feeling Fan Er'ye wouldn't let me get away with that!
Could I trouble you to ask around for me? Once you've found out, let me know and I'll figure out how to continue with the story...
*sigh* I should stick to the supernatural stories in future. They're more my forte.
Historical tales are hard work to narrate, and if you don't make it interesting enough people start complaining.
I'm definitely looking forward to the next part of old man Liu's story.
I am anxiously awaiting the next chapter!
I wonder when he's going to carry on with the story?

flow.stepDescription: Ask the audience about the story Liu Su was telling

dialogs.text: This Dr. Liu is positively infuriating...
Have you heard Liu Su's storytelling before?
Why, of course. But Dr. Liu positively infuriates me! The last time I heard him speak was at the Heyu Tea House. He was narrating <color=#00E1FFFF>Ring of Raining Blades</color>.

He'd just reached the part where the Guhua Clan was in decline. A string of martial arts practitioners came to the Guhua grounds to challenge its master while Guhua's own disciples were dropping like flies.
A few dedicated disciples stayed to the end, hoping to defend the school, but it was futile. The Guhua Clan suffered defeat after defeat, and finally someone even destroyed the Guhua plaque.

The Guhua Clan's master thought all hope was lost. He prepared to leave the school, to go and live out the rest of his days in seclusion. But just as he was about to leave, a young sword fighter entered the school gates, a prodigy who wielded the blade with a prowess like the world had never seen...
...And of all the places to stop your story; I mean, come on! "All will be revealed in the next chapter," he said... Well, the suspense is killing me!
Mark my words, the next time I lay eyes on that man he is not leaving until he tells me how this resolves!

flow.stepDescription: Ask the audience about the story Liu Su was telling

dialogs.text: This old man Liu is truly sensational...
Have you heard Liu Su's storytelling before?
You mean old man Liu? The stories he tells are second to none...
I went to hear him the last time he spoke. <color=#00E1FFFF>The Wrath of Haishan</color>, it was.
He starts off in the middle of this full-blown tempest. Howling winds, crashing waves, thunder and lightning, the lot. The Crux presses on.
At the front of the fleet is the flagship, where one person stands strong on the bow, holding themselves up with their sword. It's the captain of The Crux.
The captain watches as the billowing waves rise up and blot out the sky, and this enormous shadowy figure rises up howling from the murky depths of the ocean...

And that's where old man Liu stops, and says all will be revealed in the next chapter. I'll tell you what — it had better be! It's the mother of all cliffhangers, and he's left us hanging for days now.

flow.stepDescription: Ask the audience about the story Liu Su was telling

dialogs.text: *sigh* I wish I had more free time...
Have you heard Liu Su's storytelling before?
Liu who? ...Liu Su?
Erm... Oh yeah, I remember now. I was walking past last time he spoke, so I stopped to listen in for a bit.
Don't really remember much of it. I think the story was called <color=#00E1FFFF>Ring of Raining Blades</color> or something?
Anyway, so for whatever reason, the Guhua Clan is in a real pickle, and this big shot goes to challenge them.
I got there well after it started though, so don't ask me how it got to that point.
Anywho... the good guy's about to win, but then oh no — someone attacks him out of nowhere. So now he's on the back foot...
...Then I got called back to work. Shame, I'd love to know what happens next.
Ah, you're back. You're a star.
I just can't help the fact that the more stories I tell, the more things I forget...
So, did you ask them?
I'm definitely looking forward to the next part of old man Liu's story.
I am anxiously awaiting the next chapter!
I wonder when he's going to carry on with the story?

flow.stepDescription: Listen to Liu Su's new story

dialogs.text: Ladies and gentlemen! I trust you all wish to know how the story proceeds...
So gather round and lend me your ears, for all will be revealed in the next chapter!

...The young Guhua disciple maneuvered his blade with the swiftness of a gust of wind rustling through the trees, his myriad movements seamlessly interconnected just as a thousand raindrops converge to form a pool... His physically larger challenger caught but glimpses of his blade, glistening momentarily in the sunlight, as it tore down the mountain, ready to dominate everything in its path...

The challenger felt a sudden pain in his hand. His blade now lay some distance away on the floor; it had been prized out of his hand by the Guhua disciple's nimble bladework. Incensed at this sudden and understated defeat, the challenger was far from ready to give up the fight before it had begun...

The challenger spotted the Guhua disciple take a brief moment to catch his breath after executing his flawless strike. Instantly, the hidden weapon in the challenger's hand began to glow a dark green, and with a flick of the wrist three icy rays of light shot out from his hand, flying straight towards the Guhua disciple's face!
What had prompted the challenger's brutal retaliation? More importantly, what was about to happen to the Guhua disciple? And what would all of this mean for the fate of the Guhua Clan itself? ...

...The Guhua disciple was well-versed in martial arts. More vulnerable now that his signature sword routine had been unexpectedly cut short, he hastily raised his hilt up in defense and retreated a couple of steps. Despite struggling to maintain his balance as he stumbled back, he managed to fire off three shots from his own hidden weapon.

But before he could prepare to strike back in earnest, he saw the unarmed challenger raise himself to his full height and reach for his waist. With another flick of his wrist, out of nowhere a flexible practice blade appeared in his hand.

A menacing grin spread across the challenger's face as he watched the Guhua disciple stumble backwards. He attacked; somehow, he had now gained the upper hand in this fight. The Guhua disciple was caught completely unprepared, and struggled to defend himself.

Now on the defensive, the Guhua disciple began to tire as their blades clashed over and over again. Suddenly, there was a loud clang as his sword was swept out of his hand by his challenger. He had no time to react to this before a powerful punch landed square in his chest...

The Guhua disciple staggered backwards yet again, this time to the sound of his sword crashing to the floor. The challenger made no attempt to hide the look of smug satisfaction on his face as he raised his sword high up above his head... An unmistakable sign that the challenger intended to finish this by taking his life!
But the Guhua disciple simply rolled his head back, wagged his finger at the challenger and burst out laughing. "Good one! Really, that was a good one. But this is the point where you lose..."

...Gigantic waves loomed over the fleet as pitch-black storm clouds filled the skies. The Crux had reason to fear. For even though their ships were the finest vessels to ever sail the seas, and even though they had the finest sailors to ever man their helms...

...Even the largest of ships becomes the plaything of the ocean, tossed about on the water's surface, when Mother Nature unleashes her pent-up rage. And when those same waves of wrath meet smaller vessels, they thrust them violently into the watery abyss.

But greater trouble still was brewing. From within the towering waves emerged a dark and gargantuan beast with eyes like braziers. The terrified sailors were rendered helpless, crying out for salvation from the Geo Lord, not daring even to look at the beast.

And yet, one figure stood fearlessly on the bow of the foremost vessel, steadying themselves with their sword. This heroic figure looked out at the raging seas and the gargantuan beast as it towered like a mountain above the water's surface, and wagged their finger at it as they smiled and shouted, "Gotcha! You made sure I had to work for it this time, didn't you?"
Who was this hero, and what was this gargantuan beast? And what was the nature of the enmity between them?
Oh, you're still here! Haha. So... what did you think?
What happens next?
*tut* Both "The Wrath of Haishan" and "Ring of Raining Blades" are extremely long texts you know.
I'm not about to spend the next few hours telling you the rest of the stories. If you're interested, come to the sessions in future.
Thanks for your help today. Here, take this for your trouble. I hope I will get to see you at future sessions, too.
